Headline: Marketing Leader | TEDx Speaker | Mentor at Techstars, EBRD | Ex - Airbus, Bayer
Summary: Over the last decade of working in several companies in EU, I realised that I thrive in the "0 to 1" environment; of building a startup from ground zero, into something from nothing.   A few experiences, where I helped build from ground zero, led me to realise this fact: - A startup named Infento in Amsterdam from €0 to €1M+ in online D2C sales in a year - A startup named VU in Switzerland from €0 to €100K+ in sales in a season, and helping take it to Olympics  - Raised $848K in a Kickstarter campaign taking it from idea to success to become USA's #1 STEM crowdfunded project - An EU wide project at Airbus, taken from conception to 6 figure funding  - Bayer's premier senior executives global event from scratch to deploying €250K budget  ... and other projects of various sizes  Further, to share my learnings I began advising, and mentoring founders across USA, EU, Asia, and Africa via the accelerators Techstars, Seedstars, Founder Institute, Faster Capital, and StartupIndia - NIti Ayog.  Another area which I enjoy is coaching graduates. Sharing my experiences, and thereafter transforming the perspective of someone to believe in themselves is immensely fulfilling to me.   I coach over graduates from several universities such as Harvard, London School of Economics, IMD Switzerland, HEC Paris, Oxford, IIM and others via Evisors, and Firsthand.   I also occasionally speak on growth marketing on various stages across the globe such as TEDx, Asia Pacific Digital Marketing Conclave, Russian Stream Conference and others.   If you think we could create value mutually, feel free to reach out to me. I'm always happy to meet new likeminded folks :)
